headingLines: AI Analytics and Automation Solutions Powered by IBM watsonx
hero.subheading: BDK, Inc. is a family-owned and operated business that has been delivering managed and cloud hosting services to companies in the Mid-Atlantic and across the U.S. for 25 years. As an IBM Silver Business Partner, we deliver enterprise-level IBM watsonx solutions to companies of all sizes via our IBM and business analytics expertise. We customize watsonx solutions, working closely with customers to develop AI analytics and automation tools that work for them and meet their specific needs.

intro.heading: Getting Started with IBM watsonx + BDK
intro.body: At BDK, we offer enterprise-level IBM watsonx solutions that are designed to solve companies’ unique business problems, including skills gaps, data management issues, compliance and governance, and hybrid cloud and IT infrastructure challenges, by bringing automation and intelligence together.

solutions.heading: watsonx Solution Areas
solutions.body: Through our partnership with IBM, we offer a range of AI-powered watsonx solutions that meet your company’s data analytics, operations, document processing, and customer experience challenges.

items.title: Data
items.body: Watsonx.data allows organizations to leverage data wherever it is located to scale AI and analytics using a hybrid, open data lake. We’ll evaluate your current data landscape and develop a customized data fabric strategy that draws on data from various sources, so information can be used intelligently to make business decisions.

items.title: Assistant
items.body: Our watsonx Assistant solutions empower your company to deliver exceptional customer experience using conversational AI. BDK can develop workflows that help your business use Watson Discovery, in conjunction with Assistant, to discover deep insights in unstructured documents.

items.title: AI
items.body: Watsonx.ai empowers companies to develop powerful AI solutions using enterprise-level models. With BDK’s watsonx AI solution, your company can create automation workflows and Gen AI applications quickly and easily.

items.title: Orchestrate
items.body: Watsonx Orchestrate empowers employees through interactive AI to automate, manage, and optimize work using pre-built skills. BDK can streamline and automate your manual workflows- expanding your adoption of responsible AI and intelligent automation to reduce repetitive tasks.

why.heading: Why Work with BDK for watsonx
why.body:
When your company partners with BDK for IBM watsonx, you gain access to a team of seasoned professionals with deep expertise in automation and AI analytics. Our account managers and technical specialists collaborate seamlessly, leveraging their collective knowledge to deliver innovative, tailored solutions.
At BDK, we prioritize customer satisfaction by maintaining open lines of communication and a clear understanding of your business challenges. We excel at developing and implementing watsonx solutions that drive efficiency and insight, ensuring our customers feel supported and heard every step of the way. By focusing on IT, we empower our clients to dedicate their energy to what they do best, while we provide the technology to make it happen.

items.title: watsonx. Data Solution Brief
items.body: With watsonx.data, you can access all your data across cloud and on-premises environments. Get greater value from your data investments with an open, hybrid, governed data lakehouse that’s optimized for all data and AI workloads and puts AI to work.

items.title: Invoice Analysis Demo
items.body: This demo highlights the use of Watsonx.ai to analyze an invoice dataset for companies who are challenged in manually analyzing and mapping invoices.

items.title: Virtual Assistant Case Study
items.body: Watsonx Assistant leverages conversational AI to serve as supplemental customer service reps, with minimal training. Learn how one company’s investment increased customer engagement and improved processes and workflow automation.

cta.heading: Uncover Opportunities for AI-Powered Automation and Analytics
cta.body: Reach out to BDK to find out how IBM watsonx solutions can help your agency identify processes that can be automated for a more efficient approach to serving your country and its citizens.
